code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    marks = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 2)]
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        row_marks = [(c, v) for rr, c, v in marks if rr == r]
        left = any(c < c0 for c, v in row_marks)
        right = any(c > c1 for c, v in row_marks)
        whole_line_block = any(v == 8 for c, v in row_marks)
        if not whole_line_block and not left:
            for c in range(c0): out[r][c] = 2
        if not whole_line_block and not right:
            for c in range(c1 + 1, w): out[r][c] = 2
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        col_marks = [(r, v) for r, cc, v in marks if cc == c]
        above = any(r < r0 for r, v in col_marks)
        below = any(r > r1 for r, v in col_marks)
        whole_line_block = any(v == 8 for r, v in col_marks)
        if not whole_line_block and not above:
            for r in range(r0): out[r][c] = 2
        if not whole_line_block and not below:
            for r in range(r1 + 1, h): out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    marks = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 2)]
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        row_marks = [(c, v) for rr, c, v in marks if rr == r]
        left = any(c < c0 for c, v in row_marks)
        right = any(c > c1 for c, v in row_marks)
        whole_line_block = any(v == 8 for c, v in row_marks)
        if not whole_line_block and not left:
            for c in range(c0): out[r][c] = 2
        if not whole_line_block and not right:
            for c in range(c1 + 1, w): out[r][c] = 2
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        col_marks = [(r, v) for r, cc, v in marks if cc == c]
        above = any(r < r0 for r, v in col_marks)
        below = any(r > r1 for r, v in col_marks)
        whole_line_block = any(v == 8 for r, v in col_marks)
        if not whole_line_block and not above:
            for r in range(r0): out[r][c] = 2
        if not whole_line_block and not below:
            for r in range(r1 + 1, h): out[r][c] = 2
    return out
